# Mare Leborgne

> Boutique web design for businesses whose character deserves showing. Bespoke
> sites, designed and built one at a time, never from a template.

Mare Leborgne is a boutique web design studio in Sydney, Australia. It designs
and builds bespoke websites for businesses with real character behind them.
Founder: Augusto Leborgne. Tagline: "Sites, sur mesure." — sites, made to
measure. Contact: hello@mareleborgne.com

## Mission

A unique web presence with style, in a world full of repetition.

Great businesses and real crafts deserve more than a page that lists what they
do. They deserve a site where someone connects with their character and their
values, and immerses themselves in the experience instead of skimming past it.

In a world full of templates and AI, we need stylish, custom-made web presence
the same way we need good architecture, great products and wonderful
experiences. Style is not decoration. It is the part that says a person made
this, for this.

Augusto Leborgne started Mare Leborgne to bring style to the digital world, and
to give businesses the digital showroom they deserve.

## What the studio does

- Designs and builds bespoke websites, one business at a time.
- Carries the design process from end to end.
- No templates, no page builders, no purchased theme reskinned.
- Typography, palette and wording chosen for the individual business.

## The approach

- The studio studies the business first: how it works, what its character is,
  what it values, and what it is like to deal with.
- It then designs a site that gives the visitor the feeling of being there —
  walking into the room, handling the product, being looked after by the owner.
- Clients are not handed a page builder or asked to pick a layout. The studio
  designs it, shows it, and refines it with the client until it is right.
- Everything is made for one business. Nothing bought in, nothing reskinned.

## What clients want to know

- **The first conversation costs nothing and commits you to nothing.** The
  studio takes on only a few projects at a time, so some enquiries end in a
  recommendation elsewhere.
- **The design is shown and agreed before anything is built**, so the direction
  is settled while it is still easy to change.
- **Changes are part of the project rather than an extra.** It is not finished
  until it is right.
- **The domain, hosting, files and logins are in the client's own name** from
  the start, plus a walkthrough so they can edit their own content.
- **Pricing is not published.** Enquire and it is discussed directly.

## Where

Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. Serves Sydney and greater New South Wales.
